description: Cao Hong, solid chinese officer in the supplied pixel art style. A dark iron helmet, dark armor with gold trim and blue cloth, dark boots. A large rectangular shield with a gold rim and a gold boss on the left arm and a long spear in the right hand
face: A stern face with a dark moustache.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the dark helmet, dark armor with gold trim, the large shield on his left arm, the spear at his right side.
guard_action: the shield comes up in front of the body on the left arm, the spear is held ready at the right side, the left foot steps forward

actions.idle: Shield-and-spear guard, shield in front on the left arm, spear in the right hand, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place with shield and spear, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.b2: HORIZONTAL spear sweep, feet planted. Frames 2-6 the upper body winds far to the right, shield turning with it; frames 7-8 the spear swings around level from the side to the front; frames 9-11 hold in front. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.a3: Overhand spear stab. Frames 1-5 the spear is lifted above the right shoulder; frame 8 it is driven down over the top of the shield; frames 9-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.b3: RISING spear strike. Frames 3-6 the spear tip drops low in front; frames 7-8 it scoops up from below through the target; frame 9 it finishes high; frames 10-11 hold. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.s2: Hold the line. Frames 1-6 one step forward, weight on the front foot; frame 8 the shield is planted hard in front, spear upright at the side; frames 9-12 hold. Nothing is struck. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied ready pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton exactly. The spear stays rigid, keeps its size and shape and stays in the hand the whole time.
actions.c6: Turning thrust. The body turns once on the spot behind the shield and comes out of the turn into a straight thrust, point first; the reach is held behind the shield.
actions.a2: Shield push and thrust. The shield is pushed forward into the target first; then the spear is thrust straight past the edge of the shield, point first; the reach is held behind the shield.
actions.c3: Shield uppercut and downward thrust. The shield is swung up into the target from below; then the spear is raised and driven down over the top of the shield, point first; the reach is held low.
actions.c4: Leaping downward thrust. He crouches behind the shield, jumps, and drives the spear straight down on the target as he lands; a short hold low behind the shield.

notes: 2026-11-19 make_configs.py. 평타 b2 → a3 → b3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px), 가려진 끝은 추정.
